Load JSON fixtures from a directory

Source: R/mock.R
load_fixtures.Rd

Reads every *.json file in dir and returns a named list keyed by each file's basename without the extension (btc_book.json -> btc_book). Each value is the raw JSON string (parse = FALSE, the verbatim path that pairs with mock_response()'s string-body case) or the parsed list (parse = TRUE, via jsonlite::fromJSON() with simplifyVector = FALSE). This is how a connector loads its real captured fixtures into a route table.

Usage

load_fixtures(dir, parse = FALSE)

Arguments

dir

(scalar<character>) a directory holding *.json fixture files.

parse

(scalar<logical>) if TRUE, parse each file to a list; if FALSE (default), keep the raw JSON string.

Value

(list) a named list of fixtures (strings or parsed lists), one per *.json file; empty if dir holds none.
